name: La Vall d'Ebo (Spain)
description: Four red bars on yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of La Vall d'Ebo (a crowned shield with a star above mountains on blue).
history: Municipal flag of La Vall d'Ebo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Vall d'Ebo arms — star above mountains
